criteria.description: Validate shipped static GLB, official format validation, scale/origin, exact geometry/texture budgets and provenance.

Personally inspect each exact final frame. Concept personally inspected; keep broad entire strap and transverse open veins, reduce over-thick rope midrib and blade thickness. Before freeze actual Bjuvia and Glossopteris primary photos/text compared; both can have similar outline, only venation topology supports strong distinction. No97 mesh existed before freeze. New equal-scale neutral mesh comparison is mandatory diagnostic gate after freeze and before final selection.

Verify Single broad elongated undivided strap lamina with entire sides, rounded/tapered apex and narrowed basal attachment, not a pinnate palm leaf. One continuous strong but proportionate midrib;96 rows of near-transverse paired lateral veins remain open, never anastomosing into a net. Neutral material equal-scale comparison with pinned existing Glossopteris must expose open transverse topology versus polygonal anastomosing network; color or elongated shape alone is insufficient. One isolated Bjuvia simplex leaf-organ interpretation. Entire broad strap lamina and strong midrib with dense open parallel near-transverse lateral veins. Complete outline and0.5m size illustrative, not a complete fossil cast. No unsupported whole plant or Cycas reproductive association. Displayed96 lateral rows simplify real vein density and are not scientific counts.

scale.axes: Blender world XYZ; final transformed vertices, including caps, relief and grounding. GLB Y-up measured separately.
scale.hard_component_extent_policy: Every tagged solid component must have finite positive world extents, lie inside complete object hard bounds, and largest world extent <= complete object upper longest-axis bound. No scientific min thickness inferred. All actual transformed percomponent XYZ and PCA extents measured, with no hidden final scaling.

numeric_semantics: Integer counts are explicit construction choices, not fossil universals. Lengths/radii/widths are nominal artistic inputs; only separately declared hard world envelopes and budget ceilings are pass constraints. Actual component sizes and contact samples must be measured after every transform.
contact_policy: Each named leaf base contacts its actual parent stem/rachis; each vein physically contacts its lamina; axis junctions and petiole blends have no exposed pedestal/collar or dangling sheets. Surface samples/ray parity and multidirectional pixels required, not centers alone.
